employee_id.description: PERNR — primary linking identifier from the source workbook.

rank.description: Rank recorded on this history row.

vocation.description: VOC recorded on this history row.

appointment.description: SHORT APPT — original abbreviated appointment name, preserved verbatim.

end_date.description: APPT TO. Omitted when the source value is 9999-12-31 (open-ended).

is_open_ended.description: True when the source APPT TO was 9999-12-31.

is_current.description: True for the employee's single open-ended appointment.

duration_months.description: Inclusive duration in months, computed from the source dates. Null when open-ended.

duration_label.description: Human-readable duration, e.g. '2y 3m'. Open-ended rows show 'Current / Ongoing'.

sequence.description: Chronological position within the employee's history (1 = earliest).

source_appt_from.description: Verbatim source APPT FROM value, retained for traceability.

source_appt_to.description: Verbatim source APPT TO value, retained for traceability.

data_quality_flags.description: Flags raised while importing this row (invalid range, overlap, etc.).
